name: The Track: Slideshow
description: A slideshow that cycles through product shots in sequence. Ideal for product reveals and lookbooks by sports and fitness brands..

name: The Track: Tagline
description: A bold typographic reveal that drops a sports product onto a dark stage. Great for product drops, campaign launches, and high-impact brand moments.

name: Before & After: Side By Side
description: Before and after images placed side by side for instant comparison. Great for makeovers, product comparisons, and animated progress reels.

name: Before & After: Slider
description: A slider glide that pulls back the curtain on your transformation. Great for interior design, renovation, and reveal-style reels.

name: Before & After: Split
description: A masked reveal that splits the frame to show before and after. Great for transformations, renovations, and dramatic reveals.

name: Before & After: Swipe
description: A swipe animation that glides across to reveal the after. Great for interactive comparisons and animated transformation reveals.

name: The Prompt: Generative AI Features
description: An animated UI template walking through generative AI features. Great for AI product demos and feature announcement content where showing is more convincing than telling.

name: The Vault: Animated Cards
description: An animated card stack template where cards reveal themselves in a layered sequence. Great for fintech and product showcases where the UI needs to feel polished.

name: The Vault: Card Reveal
description: A payment card animation template with a smooth premium reveal. Great for fintech product launches and banking app showcases where the card itself is the moment.

name: The Track: Animated Metrics
description: A fitness app showcase with animated stats and data points. Perfect for product promos and feature highlight reels.

name: The Track: Animated Quote
description: An animated quote card that frames bold statements over athlete imagery. Ideal for motivational posts and brand storytelling.

name: The Track: Countdown
description: A countdown animation set inside a running-track graphic. Great for event teasers and sport campaign launches.

name: The Track: Mobile App Showcase
description: A mobile app showcase template with kinetic motion and a fast pace built for social media. Great for app promos and product launch content.

name: The Track: Personal Record
description: An animated fitness template that captures the moment a user hits a personal record. Perfect for health and workout app promos where the reward state is part of the story.

name: The Track: Promo Reel
description: A promo reel template with kinetic motion and fast pacing. Great for product launches and brand campaign content where you need to hold attention quickly.

name: The Track: Session Complete
description: An animated session completion template inspired by fitness app UI. Great for workout app promos and any product that wants to celebrate a completed action.
